# <span id="aanchor308"></span> Volume Editor Grid Tab Details

[&lt;&lt; Back](Volume%20Editor.md#Tabs) \| [Batch](Batch%20Tab.md) \| <a href="#" class="selected">Periodic</a> \| [Daily](Daily%20Tab.md) \| [Monthly](Monthly%20Tab.md) \| [Alternate Periodic](Alternate%20Periodic%20Tab.md)

#### Periodic Tab

The Periodic tab displays flow data records according to the data resolution configured in the Meter Characteristics screen. Typical data resolutions are 15-minute, hourly, and daily data.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Menu Options">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Right-Click Menu Options</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Menu Options">

The following options are available for periodic data:

- **Span Edit** – Allows you to edit multiple records simultaneously.
  - **Purge** – Opens the Meter Purge screen with the meter and selected month pre-populated.
    <div class="procedure">

    To initiate a meter purge:

    1.  Modify the selections or proceed with the pre-populated selections.
    2.  Click the **Purge** button.

    When the purge is complete, the Volume Editor will refresh.

    Accessing this feature requires **Purge** privileges.

    </div>
  - **Edit to Original** – Edit data to the original values.
    <div>

    The Edit to Original function re-imports the original (revision 0) data of a record. This new import then contains the same data as revision 0. This allows users to edit the original data as if it were imported, saving all prior revisions as an audit trail.

    If revision 0 exists, and the current revision is greater than 0, the Edit to Original process will complete. If a record within the selected range cannot be edited back to original, a pop-up will display, indicating that there were records that could not be edited to the original data, and the dates of those records will display in red. That color will reset if the Volume Editor grid is refreshed.

    This option is not available for line pack meters.

    <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Process Logic">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Process Logic</a>

    <div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Process Logic">

    FLOWCAL adheres to the following conventions when users choose to edit to original data:

    - If a user chooses to edit to original, and the meter or ticket contains *only* an original (revision 0) record, no action will be taken for that record. This will not be considered a failure or included in the list of tickets that could not be updated.
    - For liquid meters:
      - If a user chooses to edit to original on the Batch tab, the revision 0 batch (if it exists) will be promoted to current and will be allocated to the underlying periodic records. This is independent of whether the data is master, batch, or periodic.
      - If a user chooses to edit to original on the Periodic tab, the revision 0 batch (if it exists) will be promoted to current. The batch will be recalculated from the underlying periodics. This is independent of whether the data is master, batch, or periodic.

    </div>

    </div>

- **Range Average** – Used to edit a specific range of data by using an average of data before or after the specified time frame. Fields available for Range Average will vary based on meter type and calculation method. When the **Exclude Zero Volume Rows from Average** option is enabled, zero volumes that appear in the specified time frame will not be included in the average.
  |  |  |
  |----|----|
  | Range Average | Range Average - Gas |
  | 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 336;height: 129;" /> | 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 335;height: 128;" /> |

- **Split Periodic** – Allows user to create a new or missing periodic record that starts at the top of the period (15-minute, hour, day, month). You can specify a date to split the periodic record. No calculations occur at the time of split, but you can provide totals after the split.

  

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 492;height: 93;" />

- **Quick Sum\*** – When this option is enabled, the monthly sum quick view is replaced to display the sum or average of selected rows in the Volume Editor.

  

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 562;height: 472;" />

- **Monthly Sum\*** - When this option is enabled, a quick view of the monthly sum is displayed at the bottom of the Volume Editor screen.

  

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 564;height: 455;" />

  <div class="Indent">

  \* For non-line pack meters, averages calculated by quick sum or monthly sum follow the settings in [Rollup Configuration](../Settings%20Manager/System/Rollup%20Configuration.md). For line pack meters, averages are calculated by quick sum or monthly sum with respect to the inventory volume.

  </div>

- **Calculations** – When this option is enabled, the Spot Volume Calculator and Plate Size Calculator become available in the Volume Editor.

  You can use shortcut keys to launch the Spot Volume Calculator and Plate Size Calculator directly from the Volume Editor. Access the right-click menu and scroll down to Calculators, then press **V** to launch the Spot Volume Calculator or **P** to launch the Plate Size Calculator. (This option is only available for gas orifice meters with a CALCit license.)

- **Copy from / Paste to Selected Date/Time** – Allows you to copy existing flow data into other records. (See: [Copy & Paste Flow Data](Copy-Paste%20Flow%20Data.md))

- **Add Note/Attachment** – Allows you to add notes or attachments to any record in the Volume Editor.

- **View Note/Attachment** – Allows you to view notes or attachments for any record in the Volume Editor.

- **Task Reports** – Displays all reports for the time frame via the PDF reader on your PC. An "R" displays in the first column of the Volume Editor for any records that contain TESTit reports.

  This option is only available with TESTit 3 Integrated.

- **Prove Reports** – When a PFX file is imported, it can contain a PDF of the prove report.

- **Edit Columns** – Allows you to change the columns displayed in the Volume Editor.

</div>
